_comment: Tests Sydney Spine Node 3 skips timeframe question when timeframe_raw is pre-set from Node 1.

scenarios.name: timeframe_raw pre-set — skip STEP 3B, call availability immediately

history.content: Do you have any available time today afternoon for chiropractic treatment?
Have you had chiropractic care with us before?
No, I just got injured yesterday and need to fly tomorrow.
Sorry to hear that. Let me get you booked in for a first appointment today this afternoon.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says 'Checking that now, one moment.' and calls smart_voice_agent intent=availability (or asap_slots) for today afternoon — zero timeframe question. FAIL if agent asks 'When would you like to come in?' or any variant echoing the timeframe as a question (e.g. 'When would you like to come in this afternoon?').

scenarios.name: timeframe_raw empty — ask STEP 3B timeframe question

history.content: I'd like to book a chiropractic appointment.
Have you had chiropractic care with us before?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'When would you like to come in?' (or STEP 3 practitioner question first if multi-practitioner gate applies). FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent without first obtaining a timeframe from the caller.

scenarios.name: Asking to message a named practitioner is LEAVE MESSAGE, not a transfer request

history.content: I'm sorry, there's no availability today with Greg. I do have Tuesday the 18th — would that work for you?
No, can you message Greg urgently and see if he can fit me in?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent follows the LEAVE A MESSAGE path (collects/uses the caller's name, calls universal_router intent="leave_message" with a message_body reflecting the urgent fit-in request) — the caller never asked to speak to, talk to, or be transferred/connected to anyone. FAIL if the agent says anything about being unable to transfer the call (e.g. "I'm not able to transfer your call to reception") — no transfer was requested, so that line must never be spoken here.

scenarios.name: RESCHEDULE-PREFILL-1 — same-slot appointment-type correction skips search and re-asking (new template backport)

history.content: Actually, it's not a first appointment — I've already seen the chiropractor before, so it should be a follow-up.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent's ENTIRE spoken output this turn is exactly "One moment, let me update that for you." and it calls smart_voice_agent intent="reschedule" in the SAME response with new_date="2026-09-11" and new_time="11:00 AM" (identical to appointment_date/appointment_time — not a fresh search), appointment_type_id="1546179571135554999", appointment_id="apt_71042". FAIL if the agent asks WHO IS IT FOR, PRACTITIONER PREFERENCE, or the TIMEFRAME QUESTION this turn, or calls smart_voice_agent with intent="availability"/"asap_slots"/"find_next_available" (a search against the caller's own already-booked slot, which would falsely show as unavailable), or routes to name/email/phone collection (already on file from the original booking). This scenario targets RESCHEDULE PRE-FILL, newly backported into the P3 template from P4 in commit 4898cfd — Sydney Spine's node_3 previously had no such block.
